title: 静水应力与平衡电位
scope: Original analytic teaching record. Source references support the declared method/derivation only, never this invented parameter set or measurements.

creator: VoltPeer

scientific_basis.relationship: At fixed composition and electrolyte activity, tensile-positive hydrostatic stress lowers the inserted neutral Li chemical potential and raises the Li-referenced equilibrium electrode potential.

parameters.sign: sigma_h positive in tension, negative in compression
parameters.approximation: first-order isotropic small-strain coupling; composition-dependent elastic-compliance term neglected

assumptions: Independently declared parameters; no experimental or material fit.

Hydrostatic specialization of the first-order Larche-Cahn stress term. Omega=3 cm³/mol is an independently assumed teaching value, not a Si fit or the paper biaxial-film coefficient. Fixed composition/activity, small-strain isotropic thermodynamics; excludes elastic-compliance derivatives, finite-strain corrections, hysteresis and kinetic overpotential.
limitations: Hydrostatic specialization of the first-order Larche-Cahn stress term. Omega=3 cm³/mol is an independently assumed teaching value, not a Si fit or the paper biaxial-film coefficient. Fixed composition/activity, small-strain isotropic thermodynamics; excludes elastic-compliance derivatives, finite-strain corrections, hysteresis and kinetic overpotential.
A numerical/model QA pass does not validate author data or a physical mechanism.
constraints: Finite numerical values and explicit physical units.
